quote: The UI is in charge of screen-specific behavior logic such as navigation calls, click events, and obtaining permission requests.
note: 官方 UI events 頁明說導航呼叫屬 UI 層、不歸 ViewModel,並以 onXxx lambda 交給上層(onUserLogIn: () -> Unit // Caller navigates)。NavController 洩漏的後果頁面未明講,但核心主張成立。

quote: you might need additional logic to not keep advancing automatically to B. To implement this, you need additional state to indicate whether the UI should navigate to the other screen.
note: 官方頁同節範例用 rememberSaveable 的 validationInProgress + snapshotFlow{}.filter{}.flowWithLifecycle(lifecycle),導航後重設旗標,與型錄標準寫法一致。

quote: ViewModels shouldn't hold any references of lifecycle-related APIs such as the Context or Resources to prevent memory leaks.
note: 官方 ViewModel 最佳實務明講不持 Context 以免洩漏。頁面未逐字列 Activity/View/Fragment 與 @ApplicationContext,但 Context 主張成立。

quote: ViewModels shouldn't hold any references of lifecycle-related APIs such as the Context or Resources to prevent memory leaks.
note: Resources/Context 部分有官方原文支持;AndroidViewModel 與 stringResource/@StringRes 這些細節頁面未直接點名,「難測、語系過期」後果也未明講。核心(ViewModel 不持 Resources/Context)成立。

quote: You can remove these observers calling the removeObserver(Observer) method.
note: 官方 LiveData 頁:observeForever 無 LifecycleOwner、永遠 active,須自行 removeObserver;並介紹 Transformations map/switchMap 作為替代。洩漏後果為由此推得,頁面未逐字寫。

quote: ViewModel classes should prefer creating coroutines instead of exposing suspend functions to perform business logic.
note: 官方 coroutines best practices:ViewModel 應自建協程、Views 不應直接觸發協程做業務邏輯;且 viewModelScope 的協程自動撐過設定變更,lifecycleScope 則要自行處理。與型錄一致。

quote: When the ViewModelStoreOwner clears the ViewModel at the end of its lifecycle, the ViewModel also cancels the CoroutineScope.
note: 官方頁示範 onCleared(){coroutineScope.cancel()},並說 lifecycle 2.5 起可把 Closeable(如 CloseableCoroutineScope)傳進 ViewModel 建構子自動關閉;viewModelScope 於 cleared 時自動取消。

quote: Navigation graphs are also ViewModel store owners.
note: 官方 ViewModel scoping APIs:ViewModel 綁 ViewModelStoreOwner;Navigation Compose 用 navController.getBackStackEntry("parentNavigationRoute") 配 hiltViewModel(parentEntry) 取父圖範圍,與型錄標準寫法一致。activityViewModels()/navGraphViewModels 在 Views 版頁面,本次未開;錯範圍後果為推得。

quote: DON'T DO THIS! LiveData objects should not live in the repository.
note: 官方 LiveData 頁逐字舉 Repository 回傳 LiveData 並 map 重運算的反例,註解 expensive call on the main thread ... jank,並建議資料層用 Flow、ViewModel 內 asLiveData()。

quote: To ensure the system doesn't make redundant calls from an activity or fragment's onResume() method.
note: 官方頁說 onCreate 是開始 observe 的正確位置,避免 onResume 造成重複呼叫(Fragment 範例在 onViewCreated)。

quote: the callback must be unconditionally registered every time your activity is created, even if the logic of launching the other activity only happens based on user input
note: 官方 Activity Result 頁:須無條件註冊、每次建立以相同順序呼叫,可直接宣告為成員變數;並說明程序重建時結果要送回。「太晚註冊丟例外」的字面例外型別頁面未寫(You must call registerForActivityResult() before the fragment or activity is created)。

quote: Fragments outlive their views. Make sure you clean up any references to the binding class instance in the fragment's onDestroyView() method.
note: 官方 View binding 頁範例即 _binding = null 於 onDestroyView。

quote: Use getViewLifecycleOwner() as the LifecycleOwner instead of a Fragment instance when observing a LiveData object.
note: 官方 androidx 原始碼 FragmentLiveDataObserve 的 briefDescription;Fragment lifecycle 頁亦說 view lifecycle 適用於 observing LiveData that is only meant to be displayed on the screen。

quote: Prefer collecting flows using the repeatOnLifecycle API instead of collecting inside the launchWhenX APIs. As the latter APIs suspend the coroutine instead of canceling it when the Lifecycle is STOPPED, upstream flows are kept active in the background, potentially emitting new items and wasting resources.
note: 官方頁逐字支持「只暫停不取消、上游照跑」。finally/catch 碰 UI 的部分另見 ARCH-20。

quote: The repeatOnLifecycle APIs should be used when the View is created, that is in the onCreate lifecycle method for Activities, or onViewCreated in case you're using Fragments.
note: 官方 androidx 原始碼 RepeatOnLifecycleDetector(Wrong usage of repeatOnLifecycle)的 explanation,與官方 Views coroutines 頁範例(onViewCreated + viewLifecycleOwner.lifecycleScope.launch)一致。「疊多層收集」後果為推得。

quote: The repeatOnLifecycle APIs should be used with the viewLifecycleOwner in Fragments as opposed to lifecycleOwner.
note: 官方 androidx 原始碼 UnsafeRepeatOnLifecycleDetector 的 explanation,規則名與型錄一致。

quote: It is recommended to check the `Lifecycle.isAtLeast` before accessing UI in finally block.
note: 官方 androidx 原始碼 UnsafeLifecycleWhenUsage 說明:block 被取消後 finally/catch 可能在離開目標狀態後才執行;Views coroutines 頁範例註解亦寫 This line might execute after Lifecycle is DESTROYED。

quote: The Fragment lifecycle can result in a Fragment being active longer than its view.
note: 官方 androidx 原始碼 FragmentAddMenuProvider:briefDescription 為 Use getViewLifecycleOwner() as the LifecycleOwner instead of a Fragment instance;MenuHost 參考頁說明傳入 owner 時於 ON_DESTROY 移除。

quote: The Fragment lifecycle can result in a Fragment being active longer than its view.
note: 官方 androidx 原始碼 FragmentBackPressedCallback 與 FragmentAddMenuProvider 共用同一段說明,標準寫法 viewLifecycleOwner 一致。OnBackPressedDispatcher 參考頁範例用 onAttach+this 屬較舊示範,但不改變 lint 規則的官方立場。

quote: If you add a callback, you have to handle back completely in the callback.
note: 官方 androidx 原始碼 InvalidUseOfOnBackPressed:Do not call onBackPressed() within OnBackPressedDispatcher,訊息為 Should not call onBackPressed inside of OnBackPressedCallback.handledOnBackPressed。「isEnabled=false 再 dispatcher.onBackPressed」的做法與「無限遞迴」字樣原始碼未寫,為型錄推得。

quote: Avoid using the <fragment> tag to add a fragment using XML, as the <fragment> tag allows a fragment to move beyond the state of its FragmentManager. Instead, always use FragmentContainerView for adding a fragment using XML.
note: 官方 Fragment lifecycle 頁逐字支持。

quote: Using LayoutInflater.from(Context) can return a LayoutInflater that does not have the correct theme.
note: 官方 androidx 原始碼 UseGetLayoutInflater;標準寫法 layoutInflater / getLayoutInflater() 一致。「factory」一詞未寫,不影響核心。

quote: using these APIs will allow the underlying component to try to tell you _why_ it was null, and thus yield a better error message.
note: 官方 androidx 原始碼 UseRequireInsteadOfGet,含 getContext/getActivity/getArguments 對 require 版本。

quote: within the `onCreateDialog` function __must not be used__ because the `DialogFragment` owns these callbacks.
note: 官方 androidx 原始碼 DialogFragmentCallbacksDetector 對應的 explanation,標準寫法覆寫 onCancel/onDismiss 一致。

quote: You must setFragmentFactory(androidx.fragment.app.FragmentFactory) if you want to use a non-default constructor to ensure that your constructor is called when the fragment is re-instantiated.
note: 官方 Fragment 參考頁:預設工廠用預設建構子、參數建議用 setArguments/getArguments(guide 的 create 頁範例用 bundleOf + requireArguments)。ValidFragment lint 字樣本次只從非官方二手頁看到,未採用。

quote: The final call on each FragmentTransaction must commit the transaction.
note: 官方 Fragment transactions 頁,並示範 KTX fragmentManager.commit { } 區塊自動 beginTransaction 與 commit。「交易沒有執行」後果為推得。

quote: For example, to run a FragmentTransaction, you must wait until the Lifecycle is at least STARTED.
note: 官方 Views coroutines 頁;Fragment lifecycle 頁另寫 ON_STOP event the last point where it is safe to perform a FragmentTransaction on the child FragmentManager。IllegalStateException 與 commitAllowingStateLoss 狀態遺失之字面說明本次未取得,屬後果推得。
